layout.arrangement: Data-only figure slide. White canvas with dark-red bottom strip; main square plot frame upper-center; yellow badge '55' top-right. Plot is a checkerboard of alternating red/blue rectangular regions on 0-25 axes with overlaid 4-point marker clusters at lattice intersections in alternating colors. No title, legend, or axis titles.

visual_elements.description: Outer plot frame, black stroke #000000, no fill
Coordinate grid 0-25 both axes, thin boundary #000000
Checkerboard field: alternating red #FF0000 / blue #0000FF rectangular bands ~5 units wide with white #FFFFFF gaps

Marker clusters: repeated groups of four circular markers in a 4x4 layout at lattice intersections, alternating group colors #FF0000 / #0000FF; marker diameter ~4-6 px; cluster centers approx x 4, 9.4, 14.2, 20.2 and y 6.5, 15.8, 22.4 in plot coordinates [?]

typography_notes: No title. Sans-serif tick labels and badge numeral; ticks small, y labels left of plot, x labels below plot; badge '55' centered in yellow oval. Numerals only.
